# Andika

- **What:** Andika Regular, version 7.000, by SIL Global; the reading typeface (school print,
  single-storey ɑ and ɡ) for the letters and words she reads.
- **From:** https://software.sil.org/andika/download/ →
  `Andika-7.000.zip` (sha256 `88ba6ea41ef4a8e5214b090df8fa2983be1babe4843efaa99cdb6078b0e2c070`),
  the file `Andika-7.000/Andika-Regular.ttf`, unchanged
  (sha256 `27484fdc98d0d63f90407f8266e28295f6fb16d2b13c5024df0214f17152919a`).
- **Licence:** SIL Open Font License 1.1, with the Reserved Font Names "Andika" and "SIL"
  (`LICENSE.txt`, the zip's `OFL.txt`). The font file is used unchanged; the app builds a
  TextMeshPro atlas from it (`Assets/Scolita/Fonts/Andika-Regular SDF.asset`).
- **Downloaded:** 2026-11-24, by the `project-skeleton` brief.
